snippet.title: Terranigma – Rebirth Trailer
snippet.description:
A lost legend is getting ready to rise from the ashes!

Get ready to experience Quintet’s final masterpiece, on your console of choice in 2027!

The narrator in the trailer and Elle have been voiced by Nola Klop.

Terranigma will be available for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and GOG. 

Wishlist Terranigma on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4193690/Terranigma/

Follow Clear River Games on X for updates: http://www.x.com/clearrivergames
